About Kingdom 3922

A mixed kingdom that has spent most of its life fighting opponents with more of everything. This is the record, the reasoning behind it, and how the kingdom runs day to day.

Part one

The KVK record

We were never the stronger kingdom

In KVK 1 we faced 3924 and 3921, both far ahead of us on paper. They had more of every unit that decides a fight, and we went into the season knowing it. What we had was coordination, and it turned out to be enough.

1 vs 5+Krakens we could field, against what 3924 brought
10 vs 20+T5 governors on our side, against theirs
KVK 1
Won · star earned

The season we were not supposed to survive.

  • Rank 1 in DKP across the whole KVK
  • Beat kingdoms with far heavier rosters
KVK 2
Lost · FFA

A free-for-all season that did not go our way overall.

  • Won our own war against 3927, a much stronger kingdom
KVK 3
Won · no star

A win on the map, and the best allyship numbers of the season.

  • Top 3 in DKP across the KVK
  • Rank 1 in DKP inside the allyship
KVK 4
In progress

Running now. Live standings are on the DKP tab.

  • Requirements and rewards apply from day one
Part two

Always a fighter kingdom

3922 does not refuse a fight. Not because of the seed we hold, and not because of the seed the game drops us into.

Matchmaking in this game is not always fair. A D seed kingdom can be thrown into an A seed KVK, and an A seed kingdom can land in a C seed one. There is nothing to appeal to and nothing to negotiate — you get the bracket you get.

We have been on the wrong end of that twice in a row. In KVK 3 we were a C seed kingdom placed in a B seed KVK. In KVK 4 we are a C seed kingdom placed in an A seed KVK — two full brackets above where we sit.

Neither time did we sit the season out. In both we were a decisive part of the war being won. The numbers beside this are what that looks like in practice: fewer troops on the field than the enemy, and more damage coming off it.

61.7M vs 85.2MOur troop units on the field against everything the enemy brought
+116.7M vs +89.6MKill points generated by each side in that fight
Part three

History and where we stand

The same king has run this kingdom since KVK 1. Two KVKs won under that leadership, one of them with a star — three once KVK 4 lands the way it is heading.

SeasonOur seed Bracket playedAverage active
KVK 1 A seedA seed320+
KVK 2 A seedA seed · FFA250+
KVK 3 C seedB seed80+
KVK 4 C seedA seed80+

Why the headcount came down

This was a decision, not a decline. Every step of it was deliberate.

After KVK 1

320+ → 250+
  • Dead weight removed Of those 320, close to 100 were dead power or players who quit the game once the season ended. They were kicked or zeroed. Nothing was gained by carrying them.

During KVK 2

250+ → 80+
  • Twenty fighters migrated out KVK 2 can be replayed by migrating, and twenty of our active fighters left to do exactly that. We were left in a season we could no longer win on numbers.

The choice that followed

Deliberate
  • We took the kingdom down to C seed on purpose Re-entering A seed for KVK 3 would have meant migration numbers we could not reach. Rather than field a hollow kingdom in a bracket built for full ones, the king dropped 3922 to C seed and rebuilt from there. KVK 3 was then won from that position, with rank 1 DKP inside the allyship.

What was never done

Standing rule
  • Nobody who met the minimum was removed Not one governor who cleared the DKP requirement was kicked to bring the numbers down. The cuts were dead accounts, and only dead accounts.

Part seven

Ark of Osiris

Ark is the event we win most consistently. Rosters, rotations and the call during the match are handled by 22 メ AbuSarah メ.

The four matches beside this were all wins, and none of them close — the last two finished at roughly three and four times the opposing score. That is what a prepared roster looks like against one thrown together on the day.

Registering for Ark takes a slot from another governor, which is why not showing up carries a fine.

Part eight

Who plays here

3922 is a mixed kingdom, not a national one. Calls go out in English, and the alliances are used to working across time zones and languages.

Weekly forts

Fines escalate each week you miss the minimum. The count resets when you meet it again.

The rule. 100 forts per week. This applies during off-season and Home Kingdom only — not during Lost Kingdom.
  1. 1st week missed

    Activity fine

    40M Food40M Wood20M Stone20M Gold
  2. 2nd week missed

    Fine doubles

    80M Food80M Wood40M Stone40M Gold
  3. 3rd week missed

    Major fine

    240M Food240M Wood120M Stone120M Gold
  4. 4th week missed

    Removal from the kingdom

    All resources outside the bag are collected, and you are removed from Kingdom 3922. Refusing to pay ends in a full zero.

Alliance Mobilization

The minimum is 1,500 points per event.

  1. Under 1,500

    Mobilization fine

    40M Food40M Wood20M Stone20M Gold
  2. Under 1,200

    Fine and removal from K22V

    The standard fine still applies, and you are moved out of K22V for the reward distribution round.

Low DKP

KVK seats are limited. Governors who sit out a season are asked to make room.

  1. Near the minimum

    Weekly contribution until the next war

    30M of each resource — Food, Wood, Stone and Gold — every week until the next KVK begins.

  2. Far below

    Removal or zero

    Removal from the kingdom, or a zero, with 15 days allowed to migrate.

Leadership orders

Markers, rally calls and direct orders from leadership are followed as given.

  1. Judged case by case

    Penalty depends on the damage done

    Ignoring a marker or an order can cost resources, your place in the kingdom, or your troops, depending on what it cost the kingdom at the time.

Migrating to 3922

We are open to governors who can hold a march and show up for the war. Read the requirements first — they are checked, not negotiated.

Apply on Discord

The fastest route. Open a migration ticket on the kingdom server and leadership will answer you there.

Not on Discord?

Message the king directly in game. Same answer, just slower.

ittihat R5 · King

Requirements

Every line below is verified against your profile before a migration is approved.

Minimum powerMain account
55M to be considered.
Minimum kill pointsScales with power
Power × 20. A 55M governor needs 1.1B KP, a 60M governor 1.2B, a 100M governor 2B.
Troop tierNo exceptions
T5 only. T4 accounts are not accepted.
Farm accountsPer main account
Two CH25 farms per main, no more. Farms below CH25 are accepted without a limit.
Open field gearRally and garrison players excluded
If you play open field, you need at least two fully equipped marches. A full set is not required.
AlliancesFarms and teams
3922 already runs five or more farm alliances, so migrating teams and solo players do not start their own. Farm accounts join one of the kingdom's official farm alliances.

3922 farm alliances

The official farm alliances your farm accounts will be placed in. The list of alliances and their leaders is being prepared.
